changes: Dūtaka entry kept, but the notes now say the surviving 'rā' may begin a title such as rājaputra or rājakula rather than a personal name.
Purpose changed from 'grant (damaged)' to 'probably a grant (badly damaged)', following the editor.
Notes now say line 2 'sarvadā...' may be the start of an address formula or an office title (e.g. sarvadaṇḍanāyaka); no person is added for it.
Date fields confirmed. The era is left unspecified and the CE date blank, as instructed.

notes: The inscription is badly damaged; the editor says it is 'probably the grant'. Only the first syllable 'rā' of the dūtaka survives. It may be the start of a personal name, or of a title such as rājaputra or rājakula, which often come before the dūtaka's name in Licchavi grants. So the name is uncertain. Line 2 'sarvadā...' is too fragmentary to identify; it could be part of an address formula or an office title (e.g. sarvadaṇḍanāyaka). No issuing king survives. The month, fortnight and lunar day after 'saṃvat 144' are lost. Concordance: DV 183.
